description:

Admissions / Sales

Work from Office

**Location:**
Noida, Sector 2

**About Counsel Union**

Counsel Union is a practical psychology learning EdTech platform offering career-focused psychology programs for students, graduates and working professionals. Our programs focus on practical learning, professional skill development and expert-led training across multiple psychology specialisations.

We are looking for a confident and target-oriented Academic Counselor who can understand prospective students' requirements, guide them towards the right psychology program and convert qualified enquiries into successful enrollments.

**Key Responsibilities**

• Connect with prospective students through phone calls, WhatsApp, Zoom or Google Meet.

• Understand each candidate's educational background, career goals and course requirements through proper profiling.

• Counsel students about Counsel Union's psychology courses, curriculum, eligibility, duration, fees and career opportunities.

• Recommend the most suitable program based on the student's profile and objectives.

• Handle queries and objections related to course fees, certification, curriculum, career scope and learning format.

• Follow up consistently with interested leads and convert qualified enquiries into enrollments.

• Achieve daily, weekly and monthly admission and revenue targets.

• Maintain accurate lead information, follow-up notes and stages in the CRM.

• Build and manage an active sales and admissions pipeline.

• Follow up on pending payments and support candidates through the admission process.

• Maintain strong relationships with prospective students throughout the counselling journey.

• Prepare daily and weekly performance reports when required.

• Share feedback on lead quality, customer concerns and market trends with the marketing and management teams.

**Perks**

Unlimited Incentives

**Requirements**

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

• Good counselling, profiling and pitching ability.

• Strong follow-up and objection-handling skills.

• Comfortable working in a target-driven sales environment.

• Active listener with good understanding and grasping ability.

• Familiarity with CRM systems and basic sales processes.

• Ability to manage multiple leads and follow-ups efficiently.

• Prior experience in EdTech, education counselling, admissions or inside sales will be preferred.

• Psychology or education industry exposure will be an added advantage.

• Comfortable working from the office and interacting with different people every day.

title: Solution Cost Manager
description:
**Job Description Summary**
GE Vernova is seeking a Solution Cost Manager to join our HVDC team. This role is responsible for managing the cost baselines for all the HVDC reference solutions to ensure a concise, accurate and competitive cost basis is available and can be applied consistently across regions and tenders/projects. The Solution Cost Manager sits at the intersection of solution strategy, sourcing excellence, design improvement and cost competitiveness.
  
  
**Job Description**
The successful candidate will own the cost framework and baseline of each reference solution that will serve as the templates for individual bids as well as the basis for analysis and decision making as each reference solution is developed. This manager will drive the use of these cost baselines, support bid and execution teams in the correct application while coordinating contributors from various fields (NPI, Value Proposition, Sourcing, etc). A special focus shall be given on improving competitiveness, controlling risk, and protecting profitability.
  
  
**Essential Responsibilities**

* Own and develop reference solution cost baselines, templates and deployment packages, ensuring the baselines are clearly defined, accurate, user-friendly and well maintained.
* Drive the use of these cost baselines and ensure they are readily available and accessible to all users and stakeholders
* Define, maintain, and govern standard cost baselines for end-to-end reference solutions
* Work with Global Sourcing and others to keep costs up-to-date, identify any gaps and obtain costings as needed
* Operate in close coordination with the OTR cost controllers to understand actual costs from projects and use this information to refine the reference solution cost baselines
* Work with Proposal Managers to ensure that ITOC models are used correctly and efficiency
* Participate in the tender review process to support, review and ensure the consistency of the data presented
* Support bid and project teams during tender and execution phases by ensuring the correct cost baselines are used in line with intended standards and assumptions
* Coordinate Solution Line and Regional stakeholders involved in sourcing, finance and cost control ensuring alignment between processes and regional business needs
* Provide cost input for analysis and decision making associated with the development of the existing reference solutions and the establishment of new solutions as needed
* Identify, assess, and mitigate cost-related risks early in the lifecycle to improve execution readiness, reduce delivery uncertainty, and protect profitability
* Continuously evolve the reference solution cost baselines based on market needs, lessons learned, tendering and execution feedback, and business priorities
* Contribute to improving win rate, execution consistency, and margin performance by strengthening the quality, competitiveness, and use of reference solutions

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Project Management, or related field
* Demonstrated experience in cost analysis, bid management, proposal management or Finance in an engineering and/or project environment
* Proven experience developing, governing, or deploying standardized cost tools and references or reusable frameworks in a multi-project or multi-region environment
* Strong understanding of project cost control processes and industry-standard methodologies
* Experience with cost analysis tools and the ability to develop specific tools as needed to support the work
* Demonstrated ability to drive use of standardized tools and references and process improvement across cross-functional teams
* Stakeholder management and coordination skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering, tendering, regional, commercial teams
* Proven ability to identify risks, resolve cross-functional issues, and drive alignment in complex business environments
* Fluent in English with strong written and verbal communication skills

**Desired Qualifications**

* Experience in power systems, grid solutions, power conversion technologies, or other industrial infrastructure businesses
* Experience working in global organizations with regional execution models
* Familiarity with bid management, project execution, and lifecycle support processes
* Experience defining cost models, lead time assumptions, standard terms, or deployment methodologies for standard solutions
* Experience driving continuous improvement, lessons learned, and return-on-experience integration into standard offerings

******Additional Information******
**Relocation Assistance Provided:**
Yes

title: BPO Process and Presales Consultant
description:
**Role:**
BPO Presales and Process Consultant

**Location:**
Noida
**(**
*Hybrid , 3 days/week working from office*
**)**

**Experience Level:**
12-20 years

**Nature:**
Presales / advisory, customer-facing; not a proposal only role.

**Role summary**

BPO process expert in the Business Advisory Group (BAG) who can sit across from a customer's operations leader, talk their process fluently, find the gaps, and shape an AI-led optimisation story that feeds our proposals.

**Key responsibilities**

* Lead process discussions with customer ops, finance, HR or supply-chain leaders; hold the room without a delivery SME alongside
* Map as-is processes, pinpoint gaps (cycle time, cost, quality, control, experience) and size the value at stake
* Design the to-be process and its AI / automation layer: where GenAI, agents, IDP, RPA and analytics fit, and where they don't
* Turn that into proposal content for RFPs and proactive pitches: solution narrative, process flows, benefits case, transition approach
* Shape outcome-based (BITO) process bundles with the BAG product owners
* Join orals, workshops and due diligence as the process voice
* Build reusable gap-assessment templates and process playbooks for the BAG team

**Must-have experience**

Process and vertical depth weigh more than RFP tenure.

* 12+ years in BPO with hands-on operations or transformation ownership in at least two process towers, e.g. F&A (P2P, O2C, R2R), HR / Payroll, Procurement / S2P, Customer Service / Contact Centre, Claims, KYC / AML, Supply Chain
* Deep knowledge of 1–2 verticals, e.g. BFSI, Insurance, Healthcare / Life Sciences, Retail / CPG, Hi-Tech, Utilities, including the regulatory and KPI norms customers will test you on
* Worked RFPs / RFIs end to end: solution shaping, estimation inputs, win themes, orals, not content writing alone
* Designed or delivered process optimisation using AI / automation (IDP, RPA, conversational AI, GenAI copilots or agents) with measurable results: cycle time, FTE, accuracy, CSAT
* Fluent in process frameworks: Lean Six Sigma, APQC PCF, process mining (Celonis, Signavio) or equivalent
* Can run a discovery workshop and write up findings a CXO will read

**Good to have**

* Lean Six Sigma Black / Green Belt, APQC or BPM certification
* Pricing experience on outcome-based or transaction-based BPO deals
* Exposure to GBS / shared-services set-ups and transitions
* Hands-on with agentic AI platforms and their limits in regulated processes
* Prior consulting (Big 4 / advisory) or BPO solutioning tenure

**Profile fit**

* Talks process, not slideware; customer ops leaders should feel they are speaking to a peer
* Diagnostic by instinct: asks why a step exists before proposing a bot for it
* Realistic about AI: knows what is production-ready vs demo-ready
* Switches between workshop mode, deal-team mode and writing mode in the same week
* Year-1 success: credibility in customer process discussions, quality of gap-to-AI storylines in bids, reusable assets left for the team

Founders' Office Associate – Government, Partnerships and Product

Ananant Systems | Noida | Full-time | Regular travel within India | Reports to the CEO

Ananant is hiring a Founders' Office Associate to own government programmes, partnerships, product input, contracts and marketing, working directly with the CEO and CTO.

ABOUT ANANANT

Ananant Systems is an Indian deep-tech semiconductor company. We design chips for small-cell 4G/5G and camera applications, with teams in Bengaluru, Noida and San Diego. We are backed by venture capital and by national semiconductor programmes, and we are growing several-fold over the next 18 months.

THE ROLE

Outside engineering, Ananant depends on three things: the government programmes it wins, the customers and partners who adopt its chips, and its standing in the market. This role owns all three.

You will work directly with the CEO and CTO. You represent Ananant to government, partners and customers, and bring what you learn from them back into the company.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

• Government programmes. Identify, apply for and deliver government semiconductor and R&D programmes: applications, milestones, reporting and compliance, and the working relationship with the ministries and agencies involved.

• Partnerships and lead customers. Build and manage the pipeline of strategic partners and lead customers, and track every commitment made to them.

• Product and market. Bring customer requirements, market information and competitive analysis into product decisions, and build the business case for new opportunities.

• Contracts. Manage customer, partner, vendor and government agreements through review, approval and signature, working with our law firm. Maintain the contract register, renewals and obligations.

• Marketing. Own positioning, collateral, the website and our presence at industry events.

WHAT YOU WILL DELIVER

Expected outcomes in the first year:

• Government programmes won, with every report and milestone under them delivered on time.

• Partnerships signed and lead customers evaluating our chips.

• Customer and market input feeding product decisions on a regular basis.

• A complete and current contract register, with no missed renewals or obligations.

• Consistent positioning and collateral in use with customers, partners and government.

WHY THIS ROLE

• Scope. Government, customers, product, contracts and marketing in one role, each being set up for the first time.

• Direct access. You work with the CEO and CTO directly, on decisions that matter to the company.

• Sector exposure. You will build relationships and expertise across Indian semiconductor policy, customers and partners.

• A path to leadership. The role is expected to grow into leading a function as the company scales.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

1 to 5 years of experience. Comfortable both in meetings with senior government officials and partners, and in building financial models. Clear writer, strong with numbers, and able to run work end to end with limited supervision.

You bring:

• Strong Excel modelling and a solid grasp of business financials: P&L, cash flow, budgets and unit economics.

• Working knowledge of compliance and audits.

• Clear, persuasive writing and presentation for formal audiences.

• Daily, hands-on use of AI tools.

• Ability to represent the company with senior officials, partners and customers.

It helps if you have:

• An MBA, ideally with a consulting background.

• Founder or early-stage startup experience.

• An engineering degree, or experience in semiconductors, telecom or deep tech.

• Experience with Indian government programmes, public-sector stakeholders, or commercial contracts.

HOW TO APPLY

Send your CV and a short note on something you built or ran end to end, and what you would do differently. The process is a conversation with the CEO, a short work sample on a problem from the role, and a review with the founders. It takes about two weeks.

* Translate ambiguous, complex client questions into solution hypotheses, target-state architecture, and a phased path to get there.
* Build AI scenarios and value frameworks that illustrate meaningful business transformation, with measurable outcomes and a defensible business case.

Own the architecture
  
  

* Own end-to-end architecture: LLM and model-portfolio selection, context engineering, retrieval and knowledge architecture, agent orchestration, microservices, integrations, data platform touchpoints, and UI.
* Set the non-functional bar and design to it — latency, throughput, unit cost per interaction, accuracy/eval thresholds, observability, safety, security, data residency, and auditability.
* Define reference architectures, agentic blueprints, and accelerator standards for the practice; govern their reuse so pursuits start at 40% rather than zero.
* Make and document build-vs-buy and platform decisions, including model routing, fine-tuning vs prompting vs retrieval, and open vs proprietary model strategy.

Prove it
  
  

* Build prototypes, storyboards, demos, accelerators, and reusable agentic blueprints — personally on the critical path, and through the FDE pod for the rest.
* Engineer and validate AI agents for reliability, reasoning, safety, and performance; establish the evaluation and red-teaming approach that lets us state quality claims with evidence.
* Lead PoCs, pilots, and phase-0 MVPs across industries, arbitrating scope so the proof lands inside the sales cycle.

Win and hand over
  
  

* Author and quality-gate client-ready content: architecture decks, SoWs, proposals, estimates, value frameworks, risk and assumption registers, and demo storylines.
* Lead technical deep-dives, security and architecture reviews, and competitive differentiation discussions; handle the hardest objections in the room.
* Refine solution narratives based on client feedback and market conditions.
* Oversee a seamless transition from sales to delivery — architecture decision records, working code, known risks, and continuity of the people involved.

Build the practice
  
  

* Create thought leadership and reusable IP; represent the firm externally at client forums, partner events, and in published material.
* Mentor AI Leads and engineering teams; grow the bench of people who can do this role.
* Collaborate with hyperscalers and product partners to craft next-generation AI-led experiences and co-funded initiatives.

**Must-have Skills And Experience**
**Architecture and platform depth**

* Proven track record architecting and shipping production-grade GenAI/agentic systems in enterprise environments — not only pilots.
* Deep command of LLM selection and evaluation, context engineering, model routing and cost control, and the trade-offs between prompting, retrieval, tool use, and fine-tuning.
* Strong microservices and integration architecture: event-driven and API-led patterns, identity and access, secrets, multi-tenancy, and integration with core enterprise systems.
* Enterprise concerns as first-class design inputs: security, privacy, data residency, model governance, responsible AI, and regulatory constraints.

**Agentic AI engineering (hands-on)**

* Hands-on working knowledge of defining and configuring prompts, instructions, tools, reasoning strategies, guardrails, memory, and orchestration in AI agent development.
* Design and debugging of multi-agent and long-horizon workflows, including failure modes, recovery, and human-in-the-loop control points.
* Strong experience with RAG pipelines, vector databases, tokenization, and prompt engineering — including retrieval evaluation and knowledge-freshness strategy.

**Engineering craft (hands-on)**

* Hands-on experience creating and maintaining Python libraries; working command of LangChain (or equivalent orchestration frameworks), Hugging Face, OpenAI/Anthropic APIs, and locally hosted open models.
* Very strong experience developing RESTful APIs in Python with FastAPI (or similar) and integrating third-party services, UI components, and APIs.
* Hands-on Docker-based deployment, CI/CD, and disciplined use of Git/GitHub for source control and review — mandatory.
* Working knowledge of modern data platforms and their GenAI surfaces (Databricks, Snowflake Cortex, lakehouse patterns).

**Model Provider And Hyperscaler GenAI Platform Know-how**
  
  

* Broad, current understanding of the GenAI offerings across the major frontier-model providers and hyperscalers, with deep, hands-on mastery of at least one — deep enough to design on it, defend it in a client architecture review, and know where it breaks:

+ Anthropic — Claude model family, Claude API, tool use and extended thinking, Claude Agent SDK, MCP (Model Context Protocol) as an integration standard, Claude delivered via Amazon Bedrock / Vertex AI, and enterprise deployment and governance patterns.
+ OpenAI — GPT model family, Responses/Assistants APIs, Agents SDK, function calling, structured outputs, fine-tuning, batch and realtime APIs, enterprise data-handling commitments.
+ AWS — Amazon Bedrock (multi-model access, Knowledge Bases, Guardrails, Agents/AgentCore), SageMaker, and integration with AWS data, identity and security services.
+ Google — Gemini model family, Vertex AI (Model Garden, grounding, agent tooling, evaluation), and Gemini enterprise offerings.
+ Microsoft Azure — Azure OpenAI / Azure AI Foundry, AI Agent Service, AI Search for retrieval, and Azure-native identity, networking and compliance patterns.

* Able to construct and defend a multi-provider model strategy: capability-to-task mapping, model routing and tiering, benchmark and eval evidence, context-window and latency envelopes, unit economics, rate limits and capacity planning, deprecation and version-migration risk.
* Fluent in the enterprise decision criteria that actually settle these choices — data residency and sovereignty, tenant isolation, IP and training-data commitments, certifications and auditability, regional availability, and the client's existing cloud and licensing commitments.
* Designs for portability where it matters: provider-abstracted interfaces, gateway/routing layers, and prompt and eval assets that survive a model or vendor change, without over-abstracting to the point of losing provider-specific capability.
* Keeps pace with a fast-moving field and translates new releases into concrete client opportunity, filtering hype from what is production-ready.

**Consultative and commercial ability**

* Demonstrated ability to turn ambiguous business problems into crisp AI use cases with clear value hypotheses and measurable outcomes.
* Excellent communication and articulation skills; credible with a CIO/CDO and with a client's principal engineer in the same day.
* Commercial fluency: estimation, deal shaping, pricing implications of architecture choices, and the discipline to say no to a use case that will not survive contact with production.
* Hands-on prototyping mindset — able to quickly build functional demos, agent workflows, or LLM-powered interactions that accelerate client conviction.

Good to have
  
  

* Prior experience in a pre-sales, consulting, solution-architecture, or forward-deployed engineering capacity at scale.
* Recognised depth in one or more industry domains (BFSI, healthcare/life sciences, retail/CPG, manufacturing, telecom, energy).
* Experience running partner-funded or co-innovation programmes with a hyperscaler or model provider (AWS, Microsoft, Google, Anthropic, OpenAI, NVIDIA or ISV partners), including funding programmes, early-access participation, and joint go-to-market.
* Certification on a hyperscaler AI/ML or architect track, or equivalent demonstrable platform depth.
* Experience with self-hosted / open-weight model deployment (vLLM, Bedrock or Vertex custom endpoints, on-prem GPU) for clients with strict data-boundary requirements.
* Published thought leadership, patents, open-source contributions, or conference speaking on GenAI/agentic systems.

description:

excite you?

Then this opportunity is for you!

**About us:**

ConveGenius is an AI-native education infrastructure company transforming how governments, enterprises, and social institutions deliver learning and governance outcomes at population scale. Operating across B2G and B2B segments, the company partners with state governments, CSR funders, philanthropies, and social enterprises to build intelligent education ecosystems that are both impactful and commercially sustainable.

At its core, ConveGenius runs two synergistic business lines:

* **SwiftAI**
  – the intelligence and automation layer that powers citizen engagement, governance efficiency, and real-time decision-making for governments and institutions.
* **SwiftSchool**
  – the learning infrastructure layer that integrates adaptive learning, digital classrooms, and analytics to drive measurable student and system outcomes.

This dual-engine model enables ConveGenius to serve as the technology backbone for education reform — connecting classrooms, communities, and command centres through a unified AI-powered framework. Unlike traditional edtech companies that deliver content, ConveGenius builds infrastructure — platforms that integrate deeply into public delivery systems while enabling private and philanthropic partners to scale their missions with measurable results.

With operations across 22+ Indian states and partnerships with multilaterals, CSR alliances, and government departments, ConveGenius has established itself as a partner-friendly enterprise trusted for aligning policy priorities with social and financial returns. Supported by institutional investors and guided by a double bottom line philosophy, the company consistently delivers impact at scale and profitability with purpose.

As ConveGenius enters its next phase of growth, it is shaping the future of AI-led public education infrastructure — where technology, partnerships, and governance intelligence converge to redefine how nations learn and thrive.

**Learn more about us:**
https://linktr.ee/convegenius11

title: Forward Deployed Engineer IRC299933
description:
**Description**
**About the Role & Team**
We are seeking a Forward-Deployed AI Architect to help our enterprise customers radically accelerate and modernize their software delivery lifecycle. In this elite, high-impact role, you will embed directly with customer engineering teams to prove the value of AI-led engineering through hands-on architecture, agentic workflows, and measurable delivery outcomes.
  
  
This role is designed for senior architects and builders who sit at the intersection of core enterprise software architecture and cutting-edge AI engineering. You will help customers transition from traditional, ticket-bound Scrum cycles toward intent-driven, increasingly autonomous delivery models where AI tools, agents, and human governance seamlessly turn business intent into production-ready software.
  
  
**Requirements**
**Candidate Profile: Qualifications & Experience**
**Must-Have Attributes**
– Experience: 15+ years of proven experience across software engineering, architecture, product/platform engineering, or solution architecture, backed by a strong track record of product-side delivery.
  
  
– SDLC Mastery: Deep, foundational understanding of enterprise software architecture, DevSecOps pipelines, Agile/Scrum frameworks, and the broader product lifecycle.
  
  
– Hands-on AI Fluency: Direct, practical fluency with AI development tools, IDE-based AI assistants, agentic workflows, and AI-enabled software delivery. You must possess the ability to build, evaluate, and deeply explain working AI solutions.
  
  
– Modern AI Tech Stack: Experience leveraging tools and frameworks such as Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, GitHub Copilot, LangChain, AutoGen, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, MCP (Model Context Protocol), RAG, and vector databases.
  
  
– Hands on in Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), Vector Databases, Evaluation Frameworks, Prompt Engineering, Tool Calling, Function Calling, Multi-agent orchestration, AI Observability
  
  
**Good-to-Have Skills**
– Customer-Facing Excellence: Prior experience in high-touch, customer-facing technical roles (e.g., Forward-Deployed Engineer, Principal Solutions Architect, Field Engineer, or Pre-Sales Engineering Leader).
  
  
– AI Governance & Security: A strong grasp of AI governance models, human-in-the-loop controls, responsible AI frameworks, observability, and production readiness for AI-enabled enterprise systems.
  
  
Job responsibilities
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Client Engagement & Strategic Architecture

– Identify AI Opportunities: Work directly with customer engineering, product, architecture, and executive teams to diagnose SDLC bottlenecks and map out high-value areas for AI-led acceleration.
  
  
– Design & Build Proofs of Concept: Act as a hands-on builder to design, develop, and deliver working proofs utilizing modern AI engineering tools, agentic workflows, and automation frameworks.
  
  
– Lead the Intent-Driven Transition: Guide clients away from rigid, manual sprint mechanics toward fluid, intent-driven delivery loops capable of autonomously generating plans, code, tests, documentation, and validation artifacts.
  
  
  

* Value Measurement & Executive Alignment

– Quantify AI Impact: Define, measure, and report on hard engineering acceleration outcomes, including reduced cycle times, faster story-to-code conversion, improved automated testing, and accelerated code reviews.
  
  
– Technical & Executive Presentation: Communicate complex technical approaches, agentic architectures, proof results, and long-term adoption strategies to both engineering teams and C-level stakeholders.
  
  
What we offer
  
  
**Exciting Projects:**
We focus on industries like High-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.
  
  
**Collaborative Environment:**
You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!
  
  
**Work-Life Balance:**
GlobalLogic prioritizes work-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
Our dedicated Learning & Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.
  
  
**Excellent Benefits:**
We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.
  
  
**Fun Perks:**
We want you to love where you work, which is why we host sports events, cultural activities, offer food on subsidies rates, Corporate parties. Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!
  
  
**About GlobalLogic**
GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

title: Solutions Architect -  US Healthcare (RCM)
description:
**Digitide started with a simple vision:**
To transform business operations and drive growth for enterprises across the globe. For over 20 years, we’ve been at the forefront of this mission, creating lasting impact through AI-led digital solutions, smart business processes, and deep industry expertise. Our journey began as a partner to businesses looking to enhance operational efficiency and customer experiences. By combining the power of AI, data intelligence, and business process services, we’ve been able to help our clients master the digital age and stay ahead of the curve. With a global presence across 40 locations in 5 countries and a team of 55,000 dedicated associates, we deliver transformative solutions that help businesses adapt, evolve, and thrive in a constantly changing world. We’re more than just a service provider—we’re a committed partner driving meaningful impact every day. We

leverage global expertise and local insights to help customers navigate challenges and seize new opportunities. With a focus on innovation, collaboration, and results, we continue to pave the way for the future of business.

**Location: Chennai, Bangalore, Pune, Mumbai, Hyderabad**

**Job Description:**

Digitide's Healthcare vertical within International BPM serves US healthcare provider and payer clients. We are hiring a Consulting Director with deep Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) domain expertise to serve as the service line leader and subject matter expert driving consultative sales, solutioning, and high-margin growth across the Healthcare practice. This is an advisory and client-facing role — partnering closely with delivery, presales, and alliances teams to bring deep RCM domain credibility to deals, client relationships, and the broader AI-led modernization agenda.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Serve as the Healthcare/RCM domain SME across consultative sales, solutioning, and presales — bringing deep sector and regulatory context (HIPAA, CMS, payer-specific billing rules) to shape winning proposals.
* Assist delivery teams with domain expertise on patient access, medical coding, billing, and AR/denials management.
* Shape and advocate for the AI-led and platform based RCM modernization roadmap — intelligent coding assist, denial prediction/prevention, eligibility and prior-authorization automation, and patient-payment digital engagement.
* Be the client-facing domain voice in key account conversations, QBRs, and growth discussions across EN accounts.
* Identify and drive high-margin growth opportunities within existing accounts and new client pursuits (NN).
* Build and strengthen alliances and an ecosystem of technology/BPO partners relevant to RCM modernization (coding automation, AI/analytics vendors, clearinghouses).
* Represent Digitide in Healthcare-focused analyst and advisor forums, strengthening the firm's positioning and credibility in the RCM space.
* Support account teams with transition planning and solution design for new logo wins.

**Qualifications:**

* 15-17 years of experience in healthcare RCM operations or consulting, with strong exposure to consultative sales, solutioning, or advisory roles.
* Deep domain expertise across the RCM value chain — patient access, medical coding (ICD-10/CPT), charge capture, billing, AR follow-up, and denials management — for US hospital systems, physician groups, or payers.
* Track record of influencing measurable RCM performance improvement (net collection rate, days in AR, denial reduction) through technology/AI-led interventions, in an advisory or SME capacity.
* Strong client-facing and presentation skills, with experience engaging analysts, advisors, and senior client stakeholders.
* Experience building or working within a partner/alliance ecosystem (technology vendors, coding automation platforms, AI/analytics providers) in the RCM space.
* Working knowledge of US healthcare regulatory frameworks (HIPAA, CMS guidelines, payer-specific billing requirements).

**Why Join Us?**

This role puts you at the forefront of Digitide's Healthcare service line, giving you the mandate to define both the RCM domain agenda and the AI-led modernization roadmap for US provider and payer clients — a rare combination of deep domain ownership and service line leadership. You'll operate with real influence in presales and client governance, shaping proposals and QBRs with sector and regulatory depth that few delivery leaders bring to the table. You'll build without bureaucracy, in a culture that prizes speed, agility, and entrepreneurial spirit, giving you the empowerment and flexibility to build your team and service line your way, backed by 55,000 associates and a 20+ year global track record. And you'll grow at scale, joining an organization with a presence across 40 locations in 5 countries, offering the platform, resources, and runway to build something significant in Healthcare RCM and be recognized for it.

The role blends deep insurance domain expertise with hands-on solution architecture, ensuring solutions are practical, differentiated, and grounded in real insurer operating models.

The role supports pursuits and programs across major insurance markets including the US, UK, EU, Canada, ANZ, and ASEAN, requiring strong awareness of regional regulatory, operational, and technology considerations.

**Solution Architecture & Design**

* Architect end-to-end insurance solutions spanning business processes, core platforms, digital channels, data, integration, and operations.
* Design business solution architectures across P&C, Life & Annuities, Specialty, Reinsurance, Pension, and Supplemental Health.
* Develop functional and technical blueprints that clearly map client requirements to Coforge capabilities, platforms, and delivery models.
* Define business architecture, solution patterns, and reusable assets to support consistency across pursuits and programs.

**Sales & Pursuit Support**

* Partner with Sales, Client Partners, and Industry Leads to support opportunity qualification and solution shaping.
* Contribute proposals, solution sections, executive summaries, and client presentations for strategic deals.

* Ensure proposed solutions are realistic, deliverable, and aligned with delivery capabilities and constraints.
* Work closely with delivery architects and engineering teams to govern solution integrity through execution.
* Support transition from pre-sales to delivery, maintaining architectural continuity and intent.

**Technology & Industry Insight**

* Track emerging insurance platforms, core modernization approaches, cloud patterns, data architecture, and AI adoption.
* Apply industry and technology trends to evolve solution approaches and recommend modernization roadmaps.
* Contribute to the definition of new insurance offerings, accelerators, and solution assets.

**Architectural & Domain Expectations**

The Solution Architect is expected to think beyond point solutions, connecting insurer business outcomes to architecture decisions. This includes understanding insurer operating models, regulatory constraints, and modernization paths, and making pragmatic trade-offs that balance innovation with delivery feasibility.

**Required Experience, Skills & Qualifications Experience**

12 to 15 years of experience in insurance solution architecture, consulting, or large-scale transformation roles. Proven experience architecting solutions for insurers across at least two major global markets. Hands-on involvement in presales, solution shaping, and delivery transition for complex insurance engagements.

**Functional & Domain Expertise**

* Strong domain understanding across one or more insurance sub-domains: P&C, Life & Annuities, Specialty, Reinsurance, Pension, and Supplemental Health.

* Ability to translate complex architectural concepts into clear, business-friendly explanations.
* Strong collaboration skills across Sales, Industry Leads, Delivery, and Engineering teams.
* Communication & Professional Skills
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with experience contributing to executive-level solution narratives.
* Ability to influence solution direction through credibility, clarity, and structured thinking.

* Business architectural qualifications preferred.
* Strong domain knowledge in Insurance

title: Senior Manager
description:
**Title: Subject Matter Expert** 




**Location \- Noida** 




  





**About Paytm Group:** 
 Paytm is India’s leading digital payments and financial services company, which is focused on driving consumers and merchants to its platform by offering them a variety of payment use cases. Paytm provides consumers with services like utility payments and money transfers, while empowering them to pay via Paytm Payment Instruments (PPI) like Paytm Wallet, Paytm UPI, Paytm Payments Bank Netbanking, Paytm FASTag and Paytm Postpaid \- Buy Now, Pay Later. To merchants, Paytm offers acquiring devices like Soundbox, EDC, QR and Payment Gateway where payment aggregation is done through PPI and also other banks’ financial instruments. To further enhance merchants’ business, Paytm offers merchants commerce services through advertising and Paytm Mini app store. Operating on this platform leverage, the company then offers credit services such as merchant loans, personal loans and BNPL, sourced by its financial partners.
 



**About Paytm Payments Services (PPSL):** 
 PPSL enables thousands of online merchants to offer world class frictionless payment experience to their customers. We are present across large enterprises and startups including well known unicorns alike. We strive to take payments beyond an enabler and an instrument to drive revenue and user growth for our merchants. Online Payment Gateway is Paytm’s B2B Business regulated by RBI as it allows only authorized entities to conduct PA PG (Payment Aggregator Payment Gateway) business. This team is responsible for growing the penetration of Paytm’s PA PG business in the Indian merchants.
 



  





**About the role:** 
 We are looking for highly driven and customer\-focused professionals to join our Enterprise Payments team as a Subject Matter Expert (SME). The role requires working closely with Sales, Product, and Business teams to drive merchant acquisition, solution consulting, and adoption of Paytm’s payment products. The SME will play a critical role in enabling enterprise sales by providing deep domain expertise in card payments, payment workflows, and digital payment solutions. The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of the payments ecosystem, excellent stakeholder management skills, and the ability to translate complex payment solutions into business value for enterprise merchants.
 



  





**Expectations / Requirements :** 




 ● Partner closely with enterprise sales teams to drive merchant acquisition and revenue growth by acting as a payments domain expert during client discussions and solution presentations.
 



 ● Engage with CXOs, payment heads, product teams, and business stakeholders to understand merchant requirements and recommend suitable payment solutions.
 



 ● Support sales teams in pitching Paytm’s payment suite including Card Payments, Tokenisation, International Card Payments, Pre\-auth \& Capture, Payment Gateway solutions, UPI, and value\-added payment products.
 



 ● Act as a trusted advisor for merchants by providing consultative solutioning aligned with their business models, payment flows, and customer experience goals.
 



 ● Work with Product and Technology teams to identify market requirements, product gaps, and opportunities for enhancing payment offerings.
 



 ● Contribute towards product ideation, competitive benchmarking, and feedback\-driven improvements to strengthen Paytm’s market positioning.
 



 ● Drive product adoption and merchant penetration by enabling successful onboarding, training, and solution implementation.
 



 ● Lead merchant\-facing discussions for new product launches, feature enhancements, and payment optimization initiatives.
 



 ● Prepare Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), use cases, and workflow recommendations to support product enhancements and digital\-first customer journeys.
 



 ● Coordinate with cross\-functional teams including Product, Compliance, Finance, Operations, Legal, and Technology to ensure seamless execution and faster resolution of merchant requirements.
 



 ● Track industry trends, competitor offerings, and emerging technologies within the payments and fintech ecosystem to strengthen sales strategy and customer engagement.
 



  





**Superpowers / Skills that will help you succeed in this role :** 




 ● Minimum 5 years of experience in Payments, Fintech, Product Consulting, Solution Engineering, or Business Product Management with strong exposure to enterprise sales.
 



 ● Strong understanding of the card payments ecosystem including Card Processing, Tokenisation, Pre\-auth \& Capture, Payment Gateway flows, International Card Payments, and online/offline payment solutions.
 



 ● Ability to drive consultative and solution\-led sales conversations with enterprise merchants and senior stakeholders.
 



 ● Strong presentation, communication, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to simplify complex payment concepts for business audiences.
 



 ● Experience working closely with cross\-functional teams and driving alignment between Sales, Product, and Technology teams.
 



 ● Proven ability to support GTM initiatives, product adoption strategies, and customer success programs.
 



 ● Strong analytical mindset with the ability to leverage data, customer insights, and market intelligence to influence business decisions.
 



 ● A self\-starter who thrives in a fast\-paced, high\-growth, and dynamic fintech environment.
 



 ● Prior experience in fintech, payment gateways, banking, consulting, or enterprise solutioning roles will be an added advantage.
 



  





**Why join us:** 
 We give immense opportunities to make a difference and have a great time doing that. You are challenged and encouraged here to do meaningful work for yourself and customers/clients. We are successful, and our successes are rooted in our people's collective energy and unwavering focus on the customer, and how it will always be.
 



**Compensation:** 
 If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you. With enviable 500 mn\+ registered users, 21 mn\+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers \& merchants – and we are committed to it. India’s largest digital lending story is brewing here. It’s your opportunity to be a part of the story!

title: Technical Solutions Arch. Sr. Specialist - PKI ( SCEPman, DigiCert)
description:
**Req ID:** 
 368981
   

  

 NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward\-thinking organization, apply now.
   

  

 We are currently seeking a Technical Solutions Arch. Sr. Specialist \- PKI ( SCEPman, DigiCert) to join our team in NOIDA, Uttar Pradesh (IN\-UP), India (IN).
   

  

 The PKI and Encryption Specialist is responsible for the design, implementation, and daily management of the organization’s Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) and cryptographic systems. You will ensure secure communications and data integrity by managing the full lifecycle of encryption keys and digital certificates.
   

  

 Core Responsibilities
   

  

* Infrastructure Management: Maintain and support enterprise\-level PKI solutions (e.g., Microsoft ADCS, PrimeKey EJBCA, or Entrust).
* Certificate Lifecycle: Oversight of requesting, issuing, renewing, and revoking X.509 digital certificates for users, servers, and IoT devices.
* Key Governance: Manage cryptographic keys throughout their lifecycle—including generation, distribution, and secure storage—often using Hardware Security Modules (HSMs) like Thales or Entrust.
* Automation: Implement automated certificate enrollment and renewal processes using protocols like SCEP, EST, or REST APIs to prevent service outages caused by expired certificates.
* Policy \& Compliance: Develop and enforce Certificate Policy (CP) and Certification Practice Statements (CPS) to ensure alignment with industry standards like NIST or FIPS.
* Crypto\-Agility: Lead efforts to transition from legacy algorithms (e.g., SHA\-1\) to modern standards and prepare for post\-quantum cryptography.


**Technical Skills Required**
* Cryptographic Protocols: Deep understanding of TLS/SSL, SSH, PGP, and IPsec.
* Identity Management: Experience with Active Directory (AD), LDAP, and their integration with PKI for auto\-enrollment.
* Encryption Platforms: Hands\-on experience with tools like Gemalto KeySecure, Thales CipherTrust, or HashiCorp Vault.
* Cloud Security: Familiarity with cloud\-based PKI services (e.g., AWS Certificate Manager, Azure Key Vault) and "PKI as a Service" (PKIaaS) models.

title: GeM & Tendering Expert
description:
We are looking for a detail\-oriented and process\-driven GeM \& Tender Executive to manage our organization's end\-to\-end presence and business on the Government e\-Marketplace (GeM) portal and other government tender platforms (CPPP, e\-Procurement portals, state portals, etc.). The ideal candidate will have hands\-on experience across the complete GeM lifecycle — from vendor onboarding and assessment to bidding, reverse auction, forward auction, order fulfilment, and payment realization.
   




**Key Responsibilities** 

  





***GeM Portal Management***




 •     Manage day\-to\-day operations on the GeM portal including seller/vendor profile management, catalogue creation, and product/service listing.
 



 •     Ensure timely completion of vendor assessment processes, including document submission, compliance checks, and empanelment requirements.
 



 •     Monitor and maintain OEM/vendor authorization, brand approval, and product category approvals on GeM.
 



 •     Keep vendor assessment score, seller rating, and compliance metrics updated and healthy.
 



  





***Bidding \& Tendering***




 •     Search, shortlist, and evaluate relevant Bids/RFPs (Direct Purchase, L1 Bid, Custom Bid) and tenders on GeM and other e\-procurement platforms.
 



 •     Prepare and submit techno\-commercial bids, ensuring accuracy of pricing, technical specifications, and compliance with tender terms.
 



 •     Track bid submission deadlines, EMD (Earnest Money Deposit) payment, and document submission timelines.
 



 •     Coordinate with internal teams (finance, technical, logistics) for tender document preparation, pricing strategy, and eligibility criteria fulfilment.
 



  





***Reverse Auction (RA)***




 •     Participate actively in Reverse Auction (RA) events, monitoring live bidding and applying competitive pricing strategies within approved cost limits.
 



 •     Analyze competitor pricing patterns and market rates to strategize bid decrements.
 



 •     Ensure timely and accurate participation in RA to maximize win rate while maintaining profitability.
 



  





***Forward Auction***




 •     Manage and participate in Forward Auction processes on GeM, ensuring compliance with auction rules and timelines.
 



 •     Coordinate pricing approvals internally before auction participation.
 



 •     Track auction outcomes and maintain records for management review.
 



  





***Order \& Contract Management***




 •     Process Purchase Orders (PO)/Contracts received via GeM — verify terms, acknowledge orders, and coordinate execution timelines.
 



 •     Track order fulfilment status: dispatch, delivery, installation (if applicable), and consignee acceptance.
 



 •     Manage CRAC (Consignee Receipt\-cum\-Acceptance Certificate) generation and follow\-up.
 



 •     Handle order cancellations, replacements, and returns as per GeM guidelines.
 



  





***Payments \& Compliance***




 •     Track and follow up on payment realization through GeM's integrated payment system (PFMS/bill processing).
 



 •     Ensure GST invoicing, e\-way bills, and other statutory compliance for each transaction.
 



 •     Maintain documentation for performance bank guarantees (PBG), EMD refunds, and other financial instruments as required.
 



  





***Reporting \& Coordination***




 •     Maintain MIS/trackers for bids submitted, RA/FA participation, orders won, and payment status.
 



 •     Liaise with government buyers, procurement officers, and internal stakeholders to resolve queries or disputes.
 



 •     Stay updated on GeM policy changes, GFR (General Financial Rules), and CVC guidelines relevant to public procurement.
   




**Required Skills \& Competencies** 

 •     Strong working knowledge of the GeM portal — bidding, RA, FA, catalogue management, and vendor assessment modules.
 



 •     Familiarity with public procurement processes, GFR, and government tendering norms.
 



 •     Good understanding of pricing strategy and competitive bidding techniques.
 



 •     Proficiency in MS Excel, Word, and PowerPoint for tracking and reporting.
 



 •     Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple deadlines simultaneously.
 



 •     Good communication and coordination skills for liaising with government departments and internal teams.
 



 •     Basic understanding of GST, e\-invoicing, and financial documentation related to tenders.
   




**Qualifications** 

 •     Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Engineering, or related field (MBA preferred but not mandatory).
 



 •     2–5 years of relevant experience in GeM operations, government tendering, or public sector sales.
 



 •     Prior experience working with GeM Sahayak/Seller Panel is a strong plus.
